scenes.caption: A pencil and a ruler.
scenes.say: Zara has a new pencil. She wants to measure it.

scenes.caption: Start at zero.
scenes.say: She lines the pencil up with the zero on the ruler.

scenes.caption: 15 cm long.
scenes.say: The end of the pencil is at fifteen. It is fifteen centimetres long!

scenes.caption: How hot is it?
scenes.say: Now the weather. Zara reads the thermometer. It says thirty degrees.

scenes.caption: Quarter past 8.
scenes.say: School starts soon. The long hand is on the three. It is quarter past eight.

scenes.caption: Half past 8.
scenes.say: Fifteen minutes later, the long hand is on the six. It is half past eight.

scenes.caption: Quarter to 9.
scenes.say: At quarter to nine, the long hand is on the nine. The bell rings!

scenes.caption: Shukriya, Zara!
scenes.say: Rulers, thermometers and clocks. Shukriya, Zara!
